dct_description_sm: Interest was raised by Inuvialuit communities in regards to the possible presence of polar bears in the deep waters of the offshore region of the Beaufort sea. With the interest in oil and gas development, this concern was elevated and an assessment was conducted to estimate the bear density in that region. This will enable regulators to better understand potential effects of offshore oil and gas development activities on those marine mammals. Also, the results will help understand the polar bear structure in the Beaufort Sea which will lead to a long-term understanding of bear biology.
dct_title_s: Polar Bears in the Deep Offshore Regions of the Beaufort Sea, 2011-2012
